title: Murut, Bookan Language (BNB)... | Ethnologue Free
text: Bookan Murut is an endangered indigenous language of Malaysia. It belongs to the Austronesian language family. Direct evidence is lacking, but the language is thought to be used as a first language by adults only. It is not known to be taught in schools.

title: Bookan language — Grokipedia
text: Bookan, also known as Baukan Murut, is an endangered Austronesian language spoken by members of the Murut indigenous group in the Keningau district of southwestern Sabah, Malaysia.

title: Documentation of Murut, Bookan (ISO 639-3 bnb) | Culture in Crisis
text: Murut, Bookan (bnb) is an Austronesian language spoken by an estimated 2,400 bnb speakers in the interior divisions of Sabah, Malaysia. The vitality status of bnb is classified as 7-shifting at risk of language shift, attrition, and death.
